title: cnr-ibba/nf-blobpurge pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

assembly.errorMessage: assembly must be a FASTA file (.fa/.fasta/.fna, optionally gzipped) and must exist. This is the de novo assembly that was classified by sanger-tol/blobtoolkit to produce 'blobdir'.

blobdir.errorMessage: blobdir must be an existing directory: the BlobDir produced for this sample by sanger-tol/blobtoolkit (or 'blobtools create'). This pipeline never regenerates it.

reads_cram.errorMessage: reads_cram must be an existing .cram file of the short reads already aligned to 'assembly' (the same CRAM used by the upstream blobtoolkit run).
